body: Infrastructure interruption and authorized recovery: a Git maintenance temporary pack exhausted the data disk, stopping sym_cont_s1 after 1392 logged updates. Only its update-8 checkpoint exists; no final checkpoint was produced. This is an execution error, not a policy acceptance result. The single failed temporary pack (2736238592 bytes) was removed; full git fsck passed, and original Git objects remain intact. Failed logs and checkpoint are preserved separately and excluded from formal results. The user explicitly authorized one infrastructure-only rerun from the same original parent and seed, for exactly1500 updates; failed compute is accounted separately. The other nine untouched arms continue their original budgets (sym_wrap_s1 is running). The authorized retry is queued after those nine; there is no checkpoint selection, parameter scan, or added scientific model budget. A separate server-root object directory and stdout are now used for maintenance output. Formal evaluation, analysis, visual review and publication remain pending. Notion has the same incident/recovery record; Linear is not used.
